title: Welcome to the Jungle Walks Into an Empty June
subtitle: Solo Friday · 33 named cast · Hype Index 62/100
summary: Akshay's first clean solo Friday in years. Dhamaal 4 moved off June 26. 33 named cast. BCM v1.3 forecast: D1 base ₹19 Cr · 3-day WW ₹118 Cr · Lifetime ₹155 Cr nett.
